Summaries.eng: Somewhere in the world, are things that grant absolutely any kind of wish called 'kinkas'. People referred to adventurers who sought these kinkas as "bankers". Crocket, who travels with his partner Bank Menchi, is an extremely energetic young banker. His only wish is to bring his dead mother back to life. Together with Banker Uster, who he met in his travels, Crocket participates in Banker Survival.
